proof_summary: Dwork’s criterion, using Gauss congruences for the factorial ratios, gives integrality; a level-[1mρ[0m logarithmic splitting then factors the exponential into a dilated part and a correction part, whose tuple expansion is controlled for \(m\ge3\) by Legendre carry counts and the cubic Kazandzidis congruence to obtain the required \(p^{3r}\)-divisibility. The exceptional cases reduce to \(b_1(N)=\tfrac12\binom{2N}{N}\) and \(b_2(N)=\tfrac12\binom{4N}{N}\) (the latter via the Catalan series), after which Kazandzidis applies directly.
